local function createButton(posX, posY, text, w, h, callback)
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, w or 86, 0, h or 38)
	btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, posX, 0, posY)
	btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = HijauGelap
	btn.BorderSizePixel = 2
	btn.BorderColor3 = HijauTerang
	btn.Text = text
	btn.TextColor3 = Teks
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	btn.TextSize = 11
	btn.AutoLocalize = false
	btn.Active = true
	btn.ZIndex = 3
	btn.Parent = MainFrame
	btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
	return btn
end

local discoRunning = false
local discoConn = nil
BtnDisco.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if discoRunning then
		discoRunning = false
		if discoConn then discoConn:Disconnect() end
		Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(128,128,128)
		Lighting.TimeOfDay = 1200
		for _, c in pairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") then c:Destroy() end end
		BtnDisco.Text = "Disco"
	else
		discoRunning = true
		local cc = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect", Lighting)
		local counter = 0
		Lighting.TimeOfDay = 1200
		BtnDisco.Text = "Stop Disco"
		discoConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
			if not discoRunning then return end
			counter += 0.015
			local r = math.abs(math.sin(counter))
			local g = math.abs(math.sin(counter+2))
			local b = math.abs(math.sin(counter+4))
			cc.TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(r*255, g*255, b*255)
			Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(r*180, g*180, b*180)
		end)
	end
end)
